Name: ALEKO Inflatable Bounce House 12 x 10 x 8 ft with Large Curved Slide and Blower
Natural: Description: This dual-section inflatable bouncy house will provide your little ones with hours of dynamic play and exercise! This bouncer is a delightful addition to parties, family gatherings, daycare facilities, play rooms and your own backyard. This bounce house is great for commercial and residential use. This features an extra large curved slide with protective side walls, a bounce house castle, an obstacle wall, safety-netting, all-around pillars for safety and stability, an inflatable basketball hoop and an open air roof to allow ample airflow and sunshine. The extra thick 420D, 6P-free, eco-friendly Oxford fabric with PVC coating is water resistant and features heavy stitching, making this suitable for regular indoor and outdoor use. This material is also puncture-proof and heavy duty enough to support vigorous and long-lasting play. Each kit comes with everything you need to set up the bounce house, including six bouncer stakes to secure the house to the ground, a UL-approved 680 watt air blower, long fill tubes to keep the blower at a safe distance, a patch kit to repair punctures and a carrying bag to store and transport the house. This bouncy house inflates in less than a minute so youll never have to wait to play! This product can accommodate up to 5 kids at a time, or up to 500 pounds total. This is suitable for children 3 years and older.
